question: What is the tone of the passage?
solution:
The solution is **Objective.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The tone of the passage is Objective.
 
• **Objective tone is used by writer when the writer wants to **to deliver information in a neutral, factual and unbiased way. 
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about other tones given :
 
 
• **Critical - **Examines and judges carefully, especially one that expresses disapproval of what has been done.
 
• **Didactic - **Using ancient books as reference.
 
• **Subjective - **Fiction and personal essays are usually written with a subjective tone
